selection.label_basis: Two blind independent adjacent-pair annotators; every disagreement resolved by a third blind adjudicator before classifier replay.
selection.native_format_controls: Typed Codex content_item_kinds and Claude Code isMeta admission are deterministic tested controls upstream; no protocol messages are scored as human conversation.
selection.privacy: No assistant text, user text, or annotation rationale retained; exact home-relative source locators and content hashes permit local verification.
selection.scored_population: Two deterministic hash-ranked waves of eight Codex and eight Claude Code transcript windows each; four contiguous eligible user-authored exchanges per window; all v1 and development sessions excluded.
